This file INVERTS an assertion; it never removes one. A recorded program is still
expanded and still judged, and three things are findings: it passes (the record has
expired), it fails with a different code (a second defect was hiding behind the first),
or it fails with one more. A plain skip would be satisfied by the very defect it
excuses, which is the vacuity mode this project has shipped six times.
An entry belongs here only while a CAPABILITY the zone needs is missing from the
engine, and it names that capability in words a later session can act on. A defect a
session could fix today is fixed today; it does not become a record.
Ids are audit labels, so both corpora are recordable here: `library/<program>` for the
rule library this repo owns, `<campaign>/<zone>` for a campaign's zone programs.

exclusion.capability_gap: A body cannot stand on water, and `nav::standable` does not know it: any non-air cell reads as floor. `causeway` floods its ward from floor to ceiling on both flanks of a 1-wide raised spine precisely so that the flanks are not walkable, and lowering the waterline — the only repair that keeps the design — would leave water with a body-height air pocket over it, which `nav` would then call a walkable surface and the ward's whole claim would go green while being false. The repair is spec-0038 §2.1's rule one layer over, in `nav`, with its own round and its own playtest gate.
